text_block_list.text:
My days of training with the chronically
cynical
Найс Нэйчер have begun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While not possessing any exceptional
talents, she
has the ability to keep up
with the likes of
powerful runners such
as Маяно Топ Ган and
Токай Тейо.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But it's also true that she cannot seem to
reach
the top, and that weighs on her
mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Still, she continues to work toward her
dream of
becoming a superstar.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
